### 文件: index/embedding/op_kernel/arch35/embedding_simt_no_contiguous.h（Kernel侧）

#### [1] 人工检视意见

- **提出人**: zhou-qilong
- **作者**: duxinlei
- **文件**: index/embedding/op_kernel/arch35/embedding_simt_no_contiguous.h
- **行号**: 85
- **评论时间**: 2026-05-30
- **Commit**: c4b9642c1c81
- **问题描述**:

  > 检测到越界/负索引后没有跳过计算。continue 被注释掉了，仍然用 indicesVal 计算 xIndex 并写入 y。负索引的 indicesVal 会让 xIndex 为负值，导致 x 数组越界访问；超范围索引也会访问 x 的非法位置。应该在检测到越界后跳过此次赋值（恢复 continue），或者将负索引修正为 indicesVal + gatherSize、超范围索引 clamp 到 0。

- **代码片段**（行85）:
```cpp
  75 |         COM_T gatherIdx = Simt::UintDiv(yIndex, m0, shift0);
  76 |         COM_T innerIdx = yIndex - gatherIdx * innerSize;
  77 | 
  78 |         COM_T indicesVal = static_cast<COM_T>(indicesUb[gatherIdx - indicesBase]);
  79 |         COM_T xIndex = indicesVal * xDim0Stride + innerIdx * xDim1Stride;
  80 |         y[yIndex] = x[xIndex];
  81 |     }
  82 | }
  83 | 
  84 | template <typename X_T, typename INDICES_T, typename COM_T>
  85 | __aicore__ inline void EmbeddingKernelNoContiguous<X_T, INDICES_T, COM_T>::Init(GM_ADDR x, GM_ADDR indices, GM_ADDR y)
  86 | {
  87 |     xGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ X_T*)x);
  88 |     indicesGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ INDICES_T*)indices);
  89 |     yGm_.SetGlobalBuffer((__gm__ X_T*)y);
  90 | 
  91 |     currentCoreElements_ =
  92 |         GetBlockIdx() != (tilingData_->needCoreNum - 1) ? tilingData_->perCoreElements : tilingData_->lastCoreElements;
  93 |     yIndexStart_ = GetBlockIdx() * tilingData_->perCoreElements;
  94 |     COM_T yIndexEnd = yIndexStart_ + currentCoreElements_ - 1;
```

#### [2] 人工检视意见

- **提出人**: zhou-qilong
- **作者**: duxinlei
- **文件**: index/embedding/op_kernel/arch35/embedding_simt_no_contiguous.h
- **行号**: 54
- **评论时间**: 2026-05-30
- **Commit**: c4b9642c1c81
- **问题描述**:

  > writeIndexInVain1 将越界值写到 indicesGm[indicesTotalSize]，但 indicesTotalSize 的计算公式 dim0*stride[0] + dim1*stride[1] - 1 并非 indices GM 的安全写入位置。对于非连续张量，最高合法偏移是 (dim0-1)*stride[0] + (dim1-1)*stride[1]，公式结果比这多了 stride[0] + stride[1] - 1。写入位置可能超出 indices 的实际内存分配，造成内存损坏。

- **代码片段**（行54）:
```cpp
  44 |     TPipe* pipe_ = nullptr;
  45 |     COM_T currentCoreElements_ = 0;
  46 |     COM_T curIndicesNum_ = 0;
  47 |     COM_T indicesStart_ = 0;
  48 |     COM_T yIndexStart_ = 0;
  49 | };
  50 | 
  51 | template <typename X_T, typename INDICES_T, typename COM_T>
  52 | __simt_vf__ __aicore__ LAUNCH_BOUND(THREAD_NUM_LAUNCH_BOUND) inline void ComputeSimt(
  53 |     __gm__ X_T* x, __gm__ INDICES_T* indicesGm, __ubuf__ INDICES_T* indicesUb, __gm__ X_T* y, COM_T yIndexBase,
  54 |     COM_T currentCoreElements, COM_T indicesBase, COM_T curIndicesNum, COM_T m0, COM_T shift0, COM_T m1, COM_T shift1,
  55 |     COM_T indicesDim1Size, COM_T indicesDim0Stride, COM_T indicesDim1Stride, COM_T gatherSize, COM_T innerSize,
  56 |     COM_T xDim0Stride, COM_T xDim1Stride)
  57 | {
  58 |     for (COM_T index = static_cast<COM_T>(threadIdx.x); index < curIndicesNum;
  59 |          index += static_cast<COM_T>(blockDim.x)) {
  60 |         COM_T idsIndex = indicesBase + index;
  61 |         // get indices dim0 dim1 index
  62 |         COM_T dim0Idx = Simt::UintDiv(idsIndex, m1, shift1);
  63 |         COM_T dim1Idx = idsIndex - dim0Idx * indicesDim1Size;
```

### 文件: index/embedding/op_kernel/arch35/embedding_simt_two_dim.h（Kernel侧）

#### [3] 人工检视意见

- **提出人**: zhou-qilong
- **作者**: duxinlei
- **文件**: index/embedding/op_kernel/arch35/embedding_simt_two_dim.h
- **行号**: 72
- **评论时间**: 2026-05-30
- **Commit**: c4b9642c1c81
- **问题描述**:

  > 检查的是 gatherI（循环位置索引），不是 indicesValue（实际索引值）。PR目标是负索引支持，应该检查 indicesValue/indicesValueI 是否为负或超范围，而非检查 gatherI。gatherI 由 UintDiv 计算得出不可能为负；gatherI >= gatherSize 的含义也与负索引无关。另外，先从 indices[gatherI] 读取值再做检查，如果 gatherI 真的越界，读取本身就已经越界了。

- **代码片段**（行72）:
```cpp

  63 |     INDEX_SIZE_T innerI = yIndex  - gatherI * innerSize;
  64 | 
  65 |     INDICES_T indicesValue = indices[gatherI];
  66 |     INDEX_SIZE_T indicesValueI = static_cast<INDEX_SIZE_T>(indicesValue);
  67 |     INDEX_SIZE_T xIndex = indicesValueI * innerSize + innerI;

  70 | }
```

#### [6] 人工检视意见

- **提出人**: zhou-qilong
- **作者**: duxinlei
- **文件**: index/embedding/op_kernel/arch35/embedding_simt_two_dim.h
- **行号**: 74
- **评论时间**: 2026-05-30
- **Commit**: c4b9642c1c81
- **问题描述**:

  > 多个 SIMT 线程可能同时检测到越界索引，都写入同一个 vain 位置（indicesGm[indicesTotalSize] 或 indices[gatherSize]），造成 race condition。写入值不可预测，且如果其他线程在同一位置读取 indices，数据会被破坏。

- **代码片段**（行74）:
```cpp
  64 | 
  65 |     INDICES_T indicesValue = indices[gatherI];
  66 |     INDEX_SIZE_T indicesValueI = static_cast<INDEX_SIZE_T>(indicesValue);
  67 |     INDEX_SIZE_T xIndex = indicesValueI * innerSize + innerI;    
  68 |     y[yIndex] = x[xIndex];
  69 |   }
  70 | }
```
